rubric.note: Still the same straight 2x8 m tube (manifest footprint -1..1 x -4..4, walkable 1.2 m) with no jog, niche or arch: open from the previous review. Improved: the ceiling is now a chamfered walnut vault, the walls carry moulded picture-frame panels between pilasters, and the wallpaper motif is fixed. Measured on p5-rooms-corridor-hero.jpg, a near-wall gear (centre 1192,337, about 0.75 m from the eye) spans about 42-45 px of 1280, against the 120 px the previous review measured, so about 0.36x. New problem: each end bay has a dropped soffit box (hero x 560-720, y 183-205) that reads as a separate grey gable-shaped hood over the door, not as part of the vault.

Fixed: there are now three lanterns on alternating walls (lamp east at y 0, lanterns west at y -3 and +3, each with a 28 W spot pool per report.json bake_lights), and the floor has a beat. The hero centre floor strip (x 560-720) reads L* 11 near, peaks at 21 under the mid pool (rows 555-600), dips to 8.5 between pools (row 510) and rises to 16.5 under the far pool. The banner, the gilt door frames and the seam into the hall (p5-rooms-corridor-seam-from-corridor.jpg) all read. Still open: there is no runner or floor feature. New problem: both end doorways render as flat voids, RGB 0,0,0 across the whole opening in p5-rooms-corridor-floor-sealed-north.jpg (the runtime cap) and L* 3 in the hero, so the passage ends in holes, not doors. The stale p5-int-corridor-sealed.jpg (2026-11-15) showed a walnut door leaf.

Fixed: the lightmap is now 2048 px at 123.8 px/m mean (min 105.0), above the study's 66.3 and the previous 52.8. UV1 has 563 islands, 0 px overlap and a 20 px minimum gap. Fixed: the ceiling beam and cornice side faces no longer show grey streaks (lamp-shot ceiling crop). Still open, moved: the end-bay soffit underside is desaturated grey (hero region mean RGB 53,43,41, saturation 0.22, against about 0.9 for the surrounding walnut). New problem: in the lamp camera a near-camera pilaster (x 1100-1240) shows heavily stretched vertical grain and a flat orange-red side face. Wear and grain are mostly invisible because the wainscot (L* 2.2) and ceiling (L* 2.6) sit near black in the hero.

Warm and on-palette, and the pools now make light and dark beats. But the room is far too dark against the bible ('corners fall into warm dark rather than black') and the study kit. Engine hero mean L* is 5.9, with 65.5% of pixels below L* 5. The study engine hero has mean L* 17.8 with 14.3% below L* 5. The wallpaper ground is near-black crimson, RGB about 27,2,0, and the near-wall saturation is 0.86-0.90 against the study wallpaper's 0.70, so the large maroon wall area the previous review flagged is now a darker, more saturated red-black. Weighting: the darkness is mostly in the bake and the albedos, not the runtime. The Cycles diffuse reference is already dark (hero.reference-diffuse mean L* 6.2 against the study's 9.6), and the lightmap-only engine frame matches it (lightmap/Cycles frame ratio 0.86). The study's full render is 1.9x its lightmap-only frame (41.9/22.2), while the corridor's is only 1.07x (16.0/14.9), so the corridor's dark wallpaper and walnut albedos take back what AgX lifts in the study.

rubric.criterion: readability and comfort at seated VR distance
rubric.note: Improved: near-wall motifs at about 43 px and lower contrast (near-wall L* p10/p90 1.0/13.7, against 6.6/44.5 in the old build's p5-int-corridor-sealed.jpg) remove the shimmer and crowding risk the previous review raised. New problem: two thirds of the frame sits below L* 5, and on Quest 3's LCD that range black-crushes and bands, so wall panels, wainscot and ceiling will lose their form in the headset. The end doors read as black holes, not destinations. A desktop shot cannot settle the headset result.

topFixes: Lift the corridor's value into the study's range. Raise the bake light energy, or lighten the wallpaper ground and the walnut albedo, and pull the wallpaper ground saturation from about 0.88 toward the study's 0.70. Target: engine hero mean L* 14-18, fewer than 20% of pixels below L* 5, and wainscot and ceiling at L* 8 or above.
Give both ends a real door. Render the sealed runtime cap as a lit walnut door leaf (it is pure RGB 0,0,0 today), and the open hero ends as a dim lit vestibule, not a black void.

Re-material or re-UV the end-bay soffit underside (grey, saturation 0.22) so it reads as walnut continuous with the vault. Fix the stretched grain on the pilaster side faces seen by the lamp camera. Add a floor runner or inlay so the 8 m run has a floor feature.
independentScore.method: Read docs/art-bible.md and the previous independentScore in provenance.json, and re-checked each of its points. docs/verification/p4-study-*.jpg does not exist, so the study engine, Cycles and diffuse renders in assets-source/rooms/study/staging/renders/ served as the quality reference. Viewed all five engine shots docs/verification/p5-rooms-corridor-*.jpg (dated 2026-11-17 01:24, before the 01:32 commit db29fbd) and the review sheet. Measured with Pillow and numpy (CIE L*, HSV saturation): frame-level L* statistics and the fraction below L* 5; region means for wallpaper, wainscot, ceiling, end soffit, doorways, floor and lamp pools; a floor L* profile in 15 px rows; and the motif diameter from intensity profiles through a near-wall gear, cross-checked on 2x crops (hero right wall, far door and soffit, lamp-shot ceiling, lamp-shot right edge). Compared the corridor and study Cycles diffuse, lightmapped, high/low and engine renders to separate bake problems from runtime ones. Read the lightmap PNG statistics, report.json, engine-compare.json, uv1-report.json, the manifest, and bakedRoomMaterial in src/world/study-room.ts, which confirms one material path for all rooms. Weighted the engine shots first. Provenance note: report.json's files map lists stale hashes for engine-compare.json (7de03cf7..., actual 78fdd0d5...) and uv1-report.json (591d68bb..., actual f2d70682...). The GLB, KTX2 and manifest hashes match. Read-only throughout.
